output.summary: A bulbous herbaceous perennial native to Mexico, four-leaved wood-sorrel has four-part leaves and is widely grown as an ornamental. Its flowers and leaves are edible with a sharp lemon flavour, but eating too much can be harmful because its oxalic acid can interfere with nutrient absorption, especially calcium.
